lucee.notes: The request ends after the forward, like it does after [[tag-location]]. Code after the tag is not executed (Lucee 9.0 and newer, see [[breaking-changes-8-0-to-9-0]]). Use [[tag-include]] if the page has to continue after the other template.

name: cfforward
description:
Leads the request to a different page.
This tag acts like the tag cflocation except that the relocation is done directly on the server.
